content.english: I study at No.1 Middle School.
It is a beautiful school with many trees and flowers.
content.chinese: 这是一所美丽的学校，有许多树木和花朵。

content.english: There are 30 classrooms and a big library.
content.chinese: 有30间教室和一个大图书馆。

content.english: I have eight classes every day.
My favorite subject is English.
content.chinese: 我最喜欢的科目是英语。

content.english: Our English teacher is very kind.
content.chinese: 我们的英语老师非常和蔼。

content.english: I love my school very much.

keyPoints.sentence: It is a beautiful school with many trees and flowers.
keyPoints.explanation: with表示'带有'，用来描述事物的特征

keyPoints.sentence: Our English teacher is very kind.

content.english: I have a happy family.
There are four people in my family.
My father is a doctor.
He works in a hospital.
My mother is a teacher.
She teaches math at a school.
I have a little sister.
She is five years old.
We love each other very much.

keyPoints.sentence: There are four people in my family.
She teaches math at a school.
keyPoints.explanation: teach + 科目 表示'教某科目'

content.english: I get up at 7 o'clock every morning.
Then I have breakfast with my family.
content.chinese: 然后我和家人一起吃早餐。

content.english: I go to school at 7:30.
School starts at 8 o'clock.
I have lunch at school.
After school, I do my homework.
I have dinner at 6 o'clock.
Then I watch TV for a while.
I go to bed at 9 o'clock.
This is my busy but happy day.
content.chinese: 这就是我忙碌但快乐的一天。

keyPoints.sentence: I get up at 7 o'clock every morning.
keyPoints.explanation: at + 时间点 表示'在几点'

keyPoints.sentence: Then I have breakfast with my family.
After school, I do my homework.

content.english: I like many kinds of food.
My favorite food is noodles.
content.chinese: 我最喜欢的食物是面条。

content.english: I eat noodles for breakfast every day.
My mother makes delicious noodles.
content.chinese: 我妈妈做的面条非常美味。

content.english: I also like rice and vegetables.
Vegetables are good for our health.
content.chinese: 蔬菜对我们的健康有好处。

content.english: I eat fruit every day too.
Apples and bananas are my favorite.
content.chinese: 苹果和香蕉是我的最爱。

content.english: I think healthy food is important.
content.chinese: 我认为健康的食物很重要。

keyPoints.sentence: I like many kinds of food.
keyPoints.explanation: many kinds of表示'许多种类的'

keyPoints.sentence: Vegetables are good for our health.
keyPoints.explanation: be good for表示'对...有好处'

keyPoints.sentence: I think healthy food is important.

content.english: I have many hobbies.
I like reading books.
I read storybooks every evening.
I also like playing sports.
I play basketball with my friends.
content.chinese: 我和朋友们一起打篮球。

content.english: Swimming is my favorite sport.
content.chinese: 游泳是我最喜欢的运动。

content.english: I swim every weekend.
Hobbies make me happy.
What are your hobbies?

keyPoints.sentence: I play basketball with my friends.
keyPoints.explanation: play + 球类运动 表示'打/踢...'
这是一个特殊疑问句，用来询问爱好
